record.paper_title: Recent progress and open questions on the numerical index of Banach spaces
record.context_brief: Renorming and ℓ_1 in the dual
record.original_question: Let X be an infinite-dimensional real Banach space such that some equivalent norm on X has numerical index 1, that is, 1 ∈ N(X). Must the dual space X* contain an isomorphic copy of ℓ_1?

evidence.quote: Problem 18. Let X be an infinite-dimensional (real) Banach space satisfying that 1 ∈ N (X). Does X∗ contain ℓ1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a real Banach space $X$, let $\Pi(X)=\{(x,x^*)\in S_X\times S_{X^*} : x^*(x)=1\}$, where $S_X$ and $S_{X^*}$ denote the unit spheres of $X$ and its topological dual $X^*$. For a bounded linear operator $T\in\mathcal L(X)$, its numerical radius is defined by
$$v(T)=\sup\{|x^*(Tx)| : (x,x^*)\in\Pi(X)\},$$
and the numerical index of $X$ is
$$n(X)=\inf\{v(T) : T\in\mathcal L(X),\ \|T\|=1\}.$$
Let $\mathcal N(X)$ denote the set of all numbers $n(Y)$ as $Y$ ranges over Banach spaces isomorphic to $X$ (equivalently, the numerical indices of all equivalent norms on $X$).

Suppose $X$ is an infinite-dimensional real Banach space such that $1\in\mathcal N(X)$, i.e., $X$ admits an equivalent norm under which $n(X)=1$. Must the dual space $X^*$ contain an isomorphic copy of $\ell_1$?
artifact.status_search_result: Searches did not turn up a resolution of this question. Recent surveys and papers on the numerical index of Banach spaces (e.g., works of V. Kadets, M. Martín, J. Merí and collaborators on lushness and numerical index 1) continue to discuss the renorming theory but do not announce a proof or counterexample for this implication. The problem appears to still be open.

status_evidence.title: Historical Introduction: A Walk on the Results for Banach Spaces with Numerical Index 1
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on results and open problems about Banach spaces with numerical index 1.
status_evidence.claim: Recent surveys still discuss renorming questions tied to numerical index 1 without resolving whether the dual must contain ℓ_1.

status_evidence.title: A characterization of Banach spaces with numerical index one
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work aiming at characterizing infinite-dimensional Banach spaces with numerical index one.
status_evidence.claim: Characterization of infinite-dimensional spaces with numerical index 1 remains an active topic, consistent with the renorming/ℓ_1 question being unsettled.
